title: Coming Darkness
description: Survival data pack with my ideas to rebalance gameplay. It makes game passing a bit harder and longer.
body:
> `Made in 7 days to defeat my laziness. (I've lost :O)`

# Description

![Was a bit too self-confident](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cf3b29de179e656f5060591d46bccdb0e134578_0.webp)

**This is a small data pack for survival and it has gamma anti-cheat.**

I noticed some nuances when I was playing Minecraft, and so I wanted to fix a few of them via some game mechanics. No tutorial is needed because everything either is simple or displayed in game.

Everything you need to know is:

- Players that passing the game as fast as possible (even in SMPs or RP servers) are **nerfed**.
- Game a bit longer now.
